pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/CalendarRoadmapView/useCalendarRoadmapView.ts:70 Timeline-range and today-marker geometry (pure logic over milestones/deadlines) reads the wall clock itself inside a hook that also does raw fetch persistence, so time is not a parameter and the logic can't be tested without rendering a hook and faking the clock; no test covers it.
